title: Force-directed dependency network
intent: Reveal service clusters and the dependencies that connect them without assigning fixed coordinates by hand.

ai.create: Create a force-directed dependency network from typed node and edge rows, run a deterministic D3 simulation, and render links behind colored nodes with direct labels.
ai.maintain: Change force strengths or graph topology while retaining stable node and edge keys, deterministic output, padded quantitative domains, and granular D3 imports.
